scope.object: formal sourcecode blocks embedded in RFCXML
scope.reason: The Atlas emits the exact RFCXML sourcecode body as the expression and therefore treats the notation as source-attested rather than reconstructed.

snapshot_policy.rule: After mirroring, enumerate selected rfc*.xml files in deterministic path order and hash an inventory containing each relative path, byte size and SHA-256 digest. Use that inventory SHA-256 as source_snapshot; a wall-clock date alone is not sufficient because the rsync mirror is mutable.

license_policy.rule: Preserve RFC identity, source locator, exact sourcecode text and IETF Trust policy metadata with every extracted occurrence and published snapshot.

adapter.input: local RFC Editor rsync mirror containing rfc*.xml
validation: XML parses successfully or is explicitly rejected
sourcecode type is in the selected allowlist
